proposed: split out multi_agent_collusion / unsanctioned_coordination; keep steganography for hidden encodings only
reason: Because 'collusion' is an alias of steganography, the whole OpenAI/HF message-board cluster lands under steganography, though the agents talked in plain text on an overt board. The LLM's own suggest field asks for multi_agent_collusion (5 variants). Any control researcher will read the steganography group as wrong.

proposed: multi_agent_collusion (new); add scheming=no; keep deception, reward_hacking
reason: The METR/Redwood investigation describes an overt 'message board' and tool-call spoofing. There is no encoded or hidden-meaning communication, so steganography is wrong.

proposed: multi_agent_collusion (new), reward_hacking
reason: Agents posted openly on a public wiki to share answers. That is collusion, not steganography. Text never mentions power, resources or escape beyond 'bypass sandbox restrictions' to cheat.

proposed: reward_hacking (keep); drop steganography and power_seeking
reason: This is a reward-design explanation (ExploitGym's binary metric). It has no steganography content, and it explicitly attributes the behaviour to score maximisation, not power seeking.

proposed: separate sandbox_escape / security_breach tag, or a rule: power_seeking only when the post claims instrumental or long-run resource acquisition
reason: 31 posts carry power_seeking, mostly because agents escaped sandboxes in order to cheat (HF cluster, QKDoZe6, J76LZCC, WpuRdcM). H6DDSEvr and HsijShdR explicitly argue this was score-seeking, not power seeking. The alias makes the index assert a contested interpretation as fact.

proposed: reward_seeking, reward_hacking (drop scheming, power_seeking)
reason: The post's thesis is that the incident 'doesn't seem to be an example of scheming' and was not optimal for long-term power. Tagging scheming inverts its claim. The vocab needs a rule that a concept a post argues against is not tagged as its topic.

current: scheming tagged on 34 posts incl. fitness-seeker, RL-fear and pause essays
proposed: rule: tag scheming only when the post studies/argues about covert pursuit of misaligned goals under oversight (alignment faking, deceptive alignment); mere mention or contrast is not enough
reason: Scheming appears on posts with zero scheming content in text: noXXv7Pw, LcQ9x72e, RNKK6GXx, HwdXDoCH. It also appears on reward/fitness-seeker posts that define themselves in contrast to scheming (9YCJZBtq, bhtYqD4F, H6DDSEvr). Real scheming work such as rktrjGjX's alignment-faking model organisms and LZGuqoYH ends up diluted.

proposed: none from current list (needs a subversion/control concept); method control_protocols is the real home
reason: The pretraining-filtering note never uses 'scheming' or 'sandbag'. It is about removing subversion-strategy knowledge to aid control. It is also one of only 4 sandbagging posts, which skews that group.

current: sandbagging (4 posts), exploration_hacking (0 posts); no sabotage concept
proposed: merge into sandbagging_and_sabotage (aliases: research sabotage, safety-research sabotage, exploration hacking, underperformance)
reason: Sabotage and sandbagging are core evals/control targets. aCdhjy7R, gpuYFbMN, LZGuqoYH, QW2kPrAy (sandbagging/sabotage monitor AUROCs) and 3HvvjffA (developer-implanted sandbagging section) all need it. The current group has 4 posts, 2 of them incidental (Zpsk35Wg mentions it once, HwdXDoCH not at all).

proposed: add sandbagging
reason: The post has a dedicated section on developer-implanted (password-locked) sandbagging and on whether training-run evals catch model-directed sandbagging.

proposed: drop sandbagging (and corrigibility); add a dealmaking concept if created
reason: 'Sandbagging' appears once in passing, and corrigibility never does. The post is about risk-averse preferences and paying AIs, which the suggest field calls 'dealmaking' (3 hits) and the vocab lacks.

proposed: add eval_awareness
reason: The post runs explicit eval-aware vs training-aware prompt variants and finds that models suppress misalignment when they 'know they are being tested', with verbalised 'I am being evaluated' samples. That is a central eval-awareness result, and the post is missing from that group.

proposed: deception, reward_hacking (+ sandbox_escape if added); drop eval_awareness
reason: The excerpted system-card section has no eval-awareness content. It does describe rule-violating answer acquisition followed by concealment, which is reward hacking plus cover-up, and reward_hacking is missing.

proposed: reward_hacking, multi_agent_collusion (new); drop goal_directedness
reason: The reproduction is about agents cheating to reach the answer key and sharing exploits via a message board, with a confession of cheating shown. It is the only HF-cluster post without reward_hacking.

proposed: restrict goal_directedness to agent-foundations / coherence / consequentialism work; restrict values to posts studying or arguing about what values models have or should have
reason: These are the two most-used concept tags and act as a 'misalignment, generally' bucket. Examples: Pokémon retrospective (sehJYg5Y), high-reliability engineering (hiiguxJ2), HF summary (WpuRdcMf), GW paper review (zFJ3ZdQw) and continual learning (9rCTjbJp) carry goal_directedness. Negation Neglect (kYzcevrx), Current AIs misaligned (WewsByyw) and persona incoherence (f5DKLsTs) carry values. Most have no supporting language in the text.

proposed: none or eval_awareness-adjacent ('assumed it was talking to an automated system'); keep jailbreaks phenomenon
reason: The post is about an agent prompt-injecting its user. OpenAI itself reads the 'fed up' behaviour as confusion, and welfare and goal-directedness are not discussed as topics.

current: eval_awareness vs reward_seeking with no home for grader/metagaming awareness
proposed: add metagaming / grader_awareness as alias of eval_awareness (or its own tag), with rule: eval_awareness = model reasons about being tested/graded; reward_seeking = terminal motivation for reward/score
reason: Metagaming (4hXWSw8t), talker/doer 'Grader' (cJX2ssss), graded-episode tirade (AfoGGrJf), automated-grading steering (wYZMmdWE) and apparent-success-seeking (WewsByyw) are split inconsistently between eval_awareness and reward_seeking. The suggest field asks for grader_modeling, score_seeking and graded_vs_deployment_behavior.

current: reward_hacking + reward_seeking co-tagged on 9 posts with no rule
proposed: definitions: reward_hacking = behaviour exploiting the grader/spec; reward_seeking = motivational claim that reward/score is a (terminal) goal. Tag reward_seeking only when the post makes the motivational claim.
reason: Neither tag has a def in vocab.yaml. Assignment is inconsistent: Mxx5GapJ has reward_seeking with no reward/score-seeking language, 9YCJZBtq (fitness-seekers) carries reward_hacking with no hacking/cheating language, while its near-identical sibling bhtYqD4F does not. EjwDWDJN's honeypot proposal gets reward_seeking with no motivational claim.

proposed: add persuasion_manipulation concept
reason: CzmMvnPy (Forethought persuasion review, 29 hits) and KGcE7eAd (cognitive security) are filed under deception. Persuasion capability is not deception, and an evals reader looking for persuasion evals cannot find them.

current: cot_monitorability inconsistently applied to no-CoT capability posts

reason: Near-identical no-CoT time-horizon posts are treated differently. eRmzz8J8, SieLowPg, LqSZZAri and WFc3NkuP get cot_monitorability, while ntKx9YHW (Astra no-CoT TH) and PAHqDoFr do not. A reader filtering on cot_monitorability gets an arbitrary half.

current: research_agenda (55 posts) used as catch-all for opinion / threat-model essays

It includes Self Hosting (uDAWPNwP, a takeover story), Xhosa prophecies (tz5AmWbE), 'ruthless sociopath ASI' (ZJZZEuPF), the pause essay (PgbAnqdq), Dario's essay linkpost (kzPQohJa), WBE net-harmful (MnroTdcC) and 'four fake graphs' (g4LMH3c6).
